request.query: Subadditive function of finite sum bounded by sum and cardinality times uniform bound

items.name: Finset.le_sum_of_subadditive_on_pred
items.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {M : Type u_4} {N : Type u_5} [inst : AddCommMonoid M] [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid N]
  [inst_2 : PartialOrder N] [IsOrderedAddMonoid N] (f : M → N) (p : M → Prop),
  f 0 ≤ 0 →
    (∀ (x y : M), p x → p y → f (x + y) ≤ f x + f y) →
      (∀ (x y : M), p x → p y → p (x + y)) →
        ∀ (g : ι → M) {s : Finset ι}, (∀ i ∈ s, p (g i)) → f (∑ i ∈ s, g i) ≤ ∑ i ∈ s, f (g i)

items.name: Finset.apply_union_le_sum
items.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {α : Type u_2} {β : Type u_3} [inst : AddCommMonoid β] [inst_1 : PartialOrder β] [AddLeftMono β]
  {f : Set α → β},
  f ∅ = 0 →
    (∀ {s t : Set α}, f (s ∪ t) ≤ f s + f t) → ∀ {s : ι → Set α} (t : Finset ι), f (⋃ i ∈ t, s i) ≤ ∑ i ∈ t, f (s i)
